summary.en: I am a PhD student in Computer Science and Engineering at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, advised by Professor Xiaofang Zhou. My research focuses on improving the multi-turn interaction capabilities of LLM agents, including user interaction before execution and environment interaction during long-horizon execution. I also do some work on spatiotemporal data.
summary.zh: 我是香港科技大学计算机科学与工程系的博士生，导师为周晓方教授。我的研究主要关注提升大语言模型智能体的多轮交互能力，包括执行前的用户交互，以及长程任务执行过程中的环境交互。我也开展一些时空数据相关研究。

cvSummary.en: PhD student in Computer Science and Engineering at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), advised by Professor Xiaofang Zhou. My research focuses on interaction and context management for LLM agents, enabling them to maintain user intent and task goals across multi-turn, long-horizon interactions.
cvSummary.zh: 香港科技大学计算机科学与工程系博士生，导师为周晓方教授。研究聚焦大语言模型智能体的交互与上下文管理，使其在多轮、长程交互中持续维护用户意图与任务目标。
